Tested on the already-acquired real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + alignment floor.

protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-volatility surface basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-ATM IV / skew) -> subsequent relative realized volatility (BTC-minus-ETH RV spread): wrapper-free rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-71 / EVAL-73 / EVAL-74 (identical Spearman rank-IC statistic and surface reconstruction) but a different, on-charter signal family: the *cross-sectional* BTC-vs-ETH implied-vol basis rather than a single-underlying level/skew or term structure; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the cross-sectional complement to EVAL-71 (single-underlying level/skew), EVAL-73 (OOS stability) and EVAL-74 (term structure). EVAL-72/75/76 traded within-underlying signals net-of-cost; none measured the BTC-vs-ETH relative surface basis
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied-vol surface (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars) for BTC and ETH: atm_iv = amount-weighted mean iv of near-ATM trades; skew = mean(put iv) - mean(call iv); the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: rv = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars, computed per underlying on the common aligned bar grid; target = rv[BTC] - rv[ETH] (relative realized vol)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, spread_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, relative richness mean-reverts)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the realized-vol spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (surface signal x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with real iv + perp candles for BTC and ETH); no new acquisition, no network; composes the EVAL-71 floor for both underlyings with a cross-sectional alignment floor

floor.note: EVAL-77 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces and both perp series. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with a cross-sectional alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal near-ATM IV on the coarsest grid). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
